official_provider: National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting (NCMRWF), Ministry of Earth Sciences, Govt. of India

api_v2_entry.description: NRT 6hour rainfall of NRT in observations

findings.historical_archive_evidence: NCMRWF API v2 defines product_type='static_links' with base_url=None. The endpoint statically serves a single overwritten GIF file (/MERA_NRT_RADAR/Animation_last_6hr.gif). No historical calendar/file archive exists on nwp.ncmrwf.gov.in or rds.ncmrwf.gov.in for this product.
findings.accumulation_semantics: Undocumented / Non-accumulated. The visual product title specifies 'NRT Blended Rainfall at 00:00Z07SEP2026 (Satellite and DWR)' with colorbar units in mm/hr (instantaneous rain rate), not 6-hour accumulated depth (mm). Identical hash found for last_1hr, last_3hr, and last_6hr files.
findings.spatial_grid_evidence: The product is exclusively distributed as a 1200x900 pixel rendered raster image. No NetCDF, GRIB, GeoTIFF, or numeric coordinate array is published.
findings.blocking_reason: Inaccessible historical observation archive, absence of numerical gridded fields, and undocumented/non-accumulated (mm/hr instantaneous) physical units.
